items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: That belonged to Sharkey and Leon Prima... I don't know how this is taken inside... Charlie Hartman, Trombone, Sharkey, Leon Prima... That was the band that went down the floor.

ctx.x: Which dance halls do you remember?

I don't remember the names of them. Believe me, I don't. Remember the names of the bands down there? Well, that one time they had a band, there was one band down there that was where, on Elysian Fields and, uh, and Saint Bernard, which was the Hollywood. That belonged to Sharkey and Leon Prima. Mm-hmm. That was about, oh no, 35, 40. Yeah. That was a good, open, it was an open air dance hall. Where Schwegman's Grocery Store is now. Down there. And they had, uh, in fact Dave Winstein was working there. In fact the…
and you can see all of that sort of stuff in that book, what's he name wrote? Well you were in a lot of that stuff too.
